Good to know
Tags are lower-cased, and spaces or repeated underscores become one _.
An alias finds its tag, and implied tags are added when you tag a post.
A query holds at most 40 terms.
has the tag
has every tag listed
doesn\'t have the tag
has footwear or any tag under it, like boots or sneakers
the tag some_name; when tagging, the prefix makes it an artist tag (also character:, copyright: and meta:)
one person in the picture has all of these tags; girl, boy or other says who. A minus in front finds posts where no one does
two tags: spaces separate terms, so write blue_sky

high-resolution posts without sound. The server adds meta tags like lowres, highres, absurdres, wide_image, tall_image, hd, full_hd, 4k, 8k, horizontal_image, vertical_image, square_image, animated, video, sound and long_video by itself
rated safe, sensitive (s), questionable (q) or explicit (e)
any of the listed ratings
any rating but explicit
still images; also type:animation and type:video
posts in the recycle bin
the date in the file, or the upload date if it has none; also date:2024 and date:2024-03-15
from the start of the first period to the end of the last; date:2023.. and date:..2024 leave one end open
after that period; also >=, < and <=
more than 30 days old; date:<7d is less than 7 days old. Also h, w, mo and y
wider than 1920 pixels; also height:, >=, <, <=, an exact width:1920 and a range width:1000..2000
more than 8 megapixels; a bare mpixels:8 is about 8
width over height, as 16:9 or 1.78, within 0.01; ratio:1 is square and ratio:>1 is wider than tall
any size but these; a post of unknown size stays in
has this colour or, when no post does, the nearest one stored; also orange, yellow, green, teal, blue, purple, pink, brown, black, gray and white
any colour, in hex; also #2060e0 and 26e
doesn\'t have this colour
an unknown tag is normally corrected to the closest one in use; this searches tags exactly as typed
the text read in the image has the word (any case)
has all these words; quotes keep them together
the text read in the image doesn\'t have the word
newest first (the default); order:old for oldest
highest score first
highest rated first
largest file first
highest resolution first; order:mpixels too
longest side first
most tags first
most recently edited first
